basis: API-equivalent planning estimate, not a Codex subscription invoice or a dollar spending cap.
limitations: 46 calls is an explicit planning assumption, not a measured forecast. Direct delivery changes the old call mix.
Observed per-call tokens and cache ratio may not recur. Calls/compiles/hours are hard limits; dollar estimates are not.
Cache-write, fast/service-tier, regional, tool or other fees are excluded; actual signed-in Codex billing is not inferred.
Local compilation/native execution has no separately metered cloud fee in this estimate; local electricity/hardware costs are excluded.
